    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">企业微信CLI开源项目发布,支持通过CLI使用接口能力</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3 data-version="3.0.0" data-hash="6a76387ca140990d43bf1e1cdefa4a85">1.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="华文楷体">企业微信<span data-font-family="华文楷体">支持<span data-font-family="华文楷体">CLI<span data-font-family="华文楷体">开源</span></span></span></span></h3>
<div class="document">
<div class="section">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">企业微信 CLI 开源<span data-font-family="华文楷体">项目上架 Github 社区，开放<span data-font-family="华文楷体">企业微信消息、日程、<span data-font-family="华文楷体">文档、<span data-font-family="华文楷体">智能<span data-font-family="华文楷体">表格<span data-font-family="华文楷体">、<span data-font-family="华文楷体">会议、待办、通讯录等核心产品能力，支持主流 AI agent调用。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">下载地址：<a href="https://github.com/WecomTeam/wecom-cli" rel="noopener nofollow"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">GitHub</span></a></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3">2.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="华文楷体">CLI<span data-font-family="华文楷体">可使用的能力</span></span></h3>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="89.8">

</td>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">可执行的命令</span></p>

<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="89.8">

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3">3.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="华文楷体">如何安装使用CLI</span></h3>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">3.1 环境要求</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="华文楷体">Node.js（npm/npx）</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="华文楷体">企业微信机器人的 Bot ID 和 Secret<span data-font-family="华文楷体">，<span data-font-family="华文楷体">步骤<span data-font-family="华文楷体">如下<span data-font-family="华文楷体">：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">① 登录企微，进入工作台，找到「智能机器人」，并点击「手动创建」；</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">② 选择 API 模式创建；</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">③ 连接方式选择「使用长连接」，即可获取并保存Bot ID 及Secret；</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">④ 配置可见成员，并完成权限授权，保存即可完成机器人创建。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2512138/202604/2512138-20260416133745675-1420370882.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">3.2 安装</span></h4>
<pre><code data-tco-code-type="bash"><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 安装 CLI<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">npm<span data-font-family="Monaco"> <span data-font-family="Monaco">install<span data-font-family="Monaco"> -g @wecom/cli<span lang="EN-US"><br><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;<br><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 安装 CLI SKILL（必需）<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">npx skills <span data-font-family="Monaco">add<span data-font-family="Monaco"> WeComTeam/wecom-cli -y -g</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">3.3 快速开始</span></h4>
<pre><code data-tco-code-type="bash"><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 1. 配置机器人凭证（仅需一次）<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">wecom-cli init --botId <span data-font-family="Monaco">"YOUR_BOT_ID"<span data-font-family="Monaco"> --secret <span data-font-family="Monaco">"YOUR_BOT_SECRET"<span lang="EN-US"><br><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;<br><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 2. 查看支持的品类和能力<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">wecom-cli --help<span lang="EN-US"><br><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;<br><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 3. 列出某个品类下的所有工具<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">wecom-cli list contact<span lang="EN-US"><br><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;<br><span data-font-family="Monaco"># 4. 调用工具<span lang="EN-US"><br><span data-font-family="Monaco">wecom-cli call contact get_userlist <span data-font-family="Monaco">'{}'</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="华文楷体">3.<span data-font-family="华文楷体">4<span data-font-family="华文楷体"> <span data-font-family="华文楷体">包含的skills</span></span></span></span></h4>
<table>

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3">4.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="华文楷体">声明</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="华文楷体">使用要求：<span data-font-family="华文楷体">CLI的使用需要用户绑定长连接方式机器人的BOT id 和Secret授权。<span data-font-family="华文楷体">授权后<span data-font-family="华文楷体">机器人<span data-font-family="华文楷体">将以用户身份使用对应能力。同时为避免越权，授权了<span data-font-family="华文楷体">CLI能力<span data-font-family="华文楷体">的机器人将限制仅创建者可对话，其他成员不可使用。<span data-font-family="华文楷体">企业微信CLI目前优先对≤10人企业开放使用。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="华文楷体">风险提示：<span data-font-family="华文楷体">由AI agent调用CLI操作企业微信内部应用，可能受模型幻觉等影响，存在<span data-font-family="华文楷体">数据泄露、越权等风险<span data-font-family="华文楷体">。建议在测试企业中先行验证后请谨慎使用，安装使用CLI后默认用户接受潜在风险。</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
